description: This file defines interfaces related to stream generators used within the Orleans streaming framework, specifically for generator-based stream providers. It includes the IStreamGenerator interface for generating events and the IStreamGeneratorConfig interface for configuration details.

classes.name: IStreamGenerator
classes.description: Interface for stream generators used by the GeneratorStreamProvider, defining methods for reading events and configuration.

classes.name: IStreamGeneratorConfig
classes.description: Interface for configuration objects used by stream generators, providing the generator type.

methods.name: TryReadEvents
methods.description: Attempts to read events from the generator, returning true if events were read.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the stream generator with the provided service provider and configuration.

methods.name: StreamGeneratorType
methods.description: Property to get the type of the stream generator.
